title: Canonical small-site completed coefficient ring and projection comparison
statement: Let X be a scheme [def-pc-scheme], A a commutative ring and I an ideal. The constant sheafification comparison [def-weil-pbc-sheafification] on the coefficient-sized equivalent pro-etale site identifies the positive quotient diagram of [def-sfb-adic-stratified-perfect-data] with the normalized diagram of [lem-sfb-adic-perfect-model-complete-reduction]. The constructed limit isomorphism sfbModelCompletionIso commutes with every projection: its composite with the normalized nth projection equals the transported actual nth projection followed by the constant quotient comparison. This holds for all n, without any Noetherian or boundedness assumption.

source.place: Proposition 6.6.11 reverse implication, completed coefficient model calculation; equivalent-site sheafification and scalar-extension presentation of the same model

proof.text: Precomposition by AsSmall.down is an equivalence of sites. The continuous-pushforward/sheafification compatibility applied to a constant presheaf gives sfbModelConstantsIso. Its naturality for quotient transition homomorphisms assembles sfbModelSystemIso. Compose preservation of the inverse limit with the limit of this natural isomorphism to obtain sfbModelCompletionIso. The two standard limit projection identities show that its composite with the nth normalized projection is the transported nth actual projection followed by the constant comparison.

theorem sfbModelCompletionIso_projection (T : Scheme.{u}) {A : Type (u + 1)}
    [CommRing A] (I : Ideal A) (n : ℕ) :
    (sfbModelCompletionIso T I).hom ≫
        ConstantCompletion.projection (coefficientProEtaleModelTopology.{u, 0} T) A I n =
      (sfbModelRings T).map (limit.π (adicLisseRingSystem T I) (op n)) ≫
        (sfbModelConstantsIso T).hom.app (CommRingCat.of (A ⧸ I ^ (n + 1)))
